**🐛 Bug Description**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**🔄 Steps to Reproduce**
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

**✅ Expected Behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**❌ Actual Behavior**
A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

**📱 Environment**
- OS: [e.g. Windows 10, Ubuntu 20.04, macOS 12]
- Python Version: [e.g. 3.11.0]
- Bot Version: [e.g. v3.0, commit hash]
- API Mode: [Local API / Standard API]

**📋 Configuration**
- GPU Acceleration: [Enabled/Disabled]
- FFmpeg Source: [Package/System/Custom]
- File Size Limit: [e.g. 50MB, 2GB]

**📄 Logs**
```
Paste relevant portions of bot.log here (remove any bot tokens!)
```

**🎬 Video Information (if applicable)**
- Video URL: [e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...]
- Video Length: [e.g. 10 minutes]

**📷 Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**🔗 Additional Context**
Add any other context about the problem here.

**✅ Checklist**
